register.title: No free, key-less structured odds feed for Gaelic games
register.what_was_checked: OLBG Gaelic Football /25 and Hurling /26 indexes (2026-09-03), GAA.ie fixtures, ESPN site API (no GAA sport), The Odds API requires a key.
register.finding: OLBG server-rendered pages expose tipster vote counts, never prices. GAA.ie has no public JSON. No key-less Irish book consensus feed.
register.effect_on_output: Odds Strength is scored at 10 pts (prompt missing-odds rule) and flagged missing. Step 3 Full/Small Bet gates require a measured American price, so live cards resolve to SKIP. HIGH confidence is impossible without a price.

register.title: No free structured club-championship results tape
register.what_was_checked: GAA.ie fixtures-results, county board pages, OLBG club listings for Wexford/Sligo/Kilkenny (5–6 Sept 2026).
register.finding: The live OLBG slate is club championship football and hurling. Those clubs do not appear on the inter-county Wikipedia tape. County sites are HTML calendars without a key-less JSON API.
register.effect_on_output: Club fixtures are still scored and written. Form, H2H and league standing are missing (conservative caps). Two-or-more data gaps cap confidence at MEDIUM and Step 3 at Small Bet — which still SKIP without a price. Each club card carries the italic data-gap note.

register.title: Inter-county tape contains only printed scorelines
register.what_was_checked: Wikipedia 2026 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship page (fetched 2026-09-03).
register.finding: Four matches have printed goal–point scores: Connacht, Munster and Leinster provincial finals plus the All-Ireland final. Ulster (Armagh beat Monaghan) and Tailteann (Wicklow beat Down) are named as winners without a score in the fetched summary.
register.effect_on_output: Unscored matches are absent from data/gaa_results.json. Winners without scores are pedigree-only. Earlier rounds are never reconstructed.

register.title: Three-year championship pedigree is only as complete as printed 2026 holders
register.what_was_checked: All-Ireland SFC roll of honour table on Wikipedia.
register.finding: 2026 holders are listed. 2024 and 2025 scorelines were not in the fetched football championship page used for the tape, so they are not invented into rankings.
register.effect_on_output: Ranking uses the 2026 title-holder scale (Mayo 1 … Galway 8). Club sides stay unranked.

register.title: Injury, suspension and team-news have no free structured source
register.what_was_checked: RTE Sport, The42, Irish Examiner, Irish Independent — no key-less machine feed.
register.finding: The prompt asks for confirmed injuries. None can be verified automatically without scraping paywalled or JS news.
register.effect_on_output: Injuries are not scored. Confidence is not raised for 'clean bill of health'. Player names never appear in tips.

register.title: Hurling OLBG index is outside the 20-sport sitemap
register.finding: Hurling is a live tips index (id 26) but was not in the 20-sport sitemap transcription. It is collected as a GAA sub-code, not a 21st registry sport, so tile counts stay honest.
register.effect_on_output: Hurling markets appear on gaa.html?code=hurling. Limerick/Kilkenny pedigree weighting applies only when those county names are the sides — club names such as Tullaroan do not inherit it.
